nodes.text:
Beasts gone from a shut fold. No wolf sign. No fence down. Nothing eaten. I have herded forty years and I have no word for it, and I am not saying the number out loud.

Sunn can read the ground. I cannot leave the fold to fetch her.

choices.text: What do you think it was?

nodes.text: I think a herd that will stand in a fold while wolves sing needs a better reason to walk out of one at night. And I think I do not want to meet the reason. Go careful.
Dawn, at the butts, or already on the fell. Tell her the fold count is wrong and she will come before you finish the sentence.
Then pray at whatever you pray at that it stays a herd problem.
